title: MEIKO — Narrator Of Happiness〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everyone, do you all have your drinks ready?!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Ready☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're ready as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Us too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, I believe we're all set.
The floor is yours, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nene, Rui, Emu!
A job well done on the anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next, Miku, all of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We know we caused you all a lot of concern, but we managed to get to our new starting line! Thank you very much for supporting us the entire way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, here's to a successful anniversary show, and to new beginnings.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Rui & Emu
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Cheeers!
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ahh! This juice is so yummy and cool!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I kept the drinks cool until just now using my refrigeration module.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. You can store drinks and stuff for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
There's a clear reason for that.
I installed it so we can quickly rehydrate after practices.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see.
I thought this was just another passing fancy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A passing fancy...?
Honestly, Tsukasa, Nene, who do you take me for exactly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I spend all this time coming up with gizmos and gadgets for the actors performing in our shows...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Tsukasa and Nene are bullying Rui!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh dear. Naughty children need to be punished by having an ice-cold glass of juice caress their necks♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Haha! Oh no☆
You two gotta run♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, that might be nice if they're all this temperature.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone's smiling and having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They really are!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what was going to happen after they decided to become freelancers, and after Emu made her initial decision.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Hehe... So much fun...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh...? Oh, Luka...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. She must feel so relieved to see that they're all smiling now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: MEIKO, are you guys eating? These chocolates are super yummy!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Really? Then, I'd like to try one!
Also, would you mind saving one for Luka? I'm sure she'll want one after she wakes up later.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you all again for inviting us to join you for this after-party.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As always, you were all there for us when we really needed it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, you, MEIKO and the others inspired us to change the ending of the anniversary show through your own show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I was so surprised when I saw your new ending! I couldn't believe how wonderfully happy it was♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We decided to go with that after discussing it as a troupe. We wanted it to reflect our current situation.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, I see!
And I'm really glad you went with that ending!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If I recall, “They made shows together while pursuing their dreams forever after,” yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna meet lots of new people, experience lots of new things, come back to Phoenix Wonderland and fill it with even more smiles!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I of course plan to learn as much as I can in order to become a star in the future!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want to hone my skills so that I can become an actress who performs around the world.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I'm going to put on a show with my dear friends that connects people around the world through their smiles.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Those are all such wonderful dreams.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they are!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe☆ But we can't let them hog all the glory♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We should also put on lots and lots of shows that can make lots and lots of people smile!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna figure out how to put on even better shows so we can help Tsukasa and the others when they think they need it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that would be wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'll sleep a lot and...
See lots of wonderful dreams... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka.
We weren't talking about those kinds of dreams.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
